name: verifiable-certificates
description: Privacy-preserving, revocable course certificates on Hedera: AnonCreds credentials (Credo, OpenWallet Foundation) with Hedera as the Verifiable Data Registry, a downloadable PDF stored on HCS-1, an accreditation registry contract, and a relying party that decides enrollment from a zero-knowledge proof. Next.js + Hardhat + a shared TypeScript SDK.

envVars.description: Network the app targets: testnet (default) or mainnet. Certificates need a public network.
Mirror Node REST URL for the selected network. Empty uses the public Hedera Mirror Node.
Operator account ID (0.0.x) that pays for the issuer's HCS topics and messages. Required by yarn setup.
Private key of the operator account (DER, or raw hex: its curve is read from the account). Server-side only. Secret: never commit it and never expose it to the browser.
Minimum operator balance in HBAR that yarn setup requires. Empty uses the default for the selected network (20 on testnet, 10 on mainnet).
Directory for the local agent wallets (Askar), the issuer identifiers and the tails files, relative to the repository root. Empty uses .data (git-ignored).
Public origin of the app, printed in the certificate QR code and in the revocation registry's tails URL. Empty uses http://localhost:3000.

steps.label: Create your local environment file
steps.text: Set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY. The file is git-ignored. Never commit keys.

steps.label: Publish the issuer and the accreditation registry on Hedera (once; about 12 HBAR, asks before paying)
Start the app and open http://localhost:3000
